level.description: basic = 'Grundkenntnisse', A1-A2, 'basic'; good = 'gute Kenntnisse', B1-B2, 'good'; fluent = 'fließend', 'verhandlungssicher', 'sehr gut', C1-C2, 'fluent', 'business fluent'; native = 'Muttersprache', 'native'; unspecified = the language is required but no level is stated.

city.description: City as written in the posting, without postcode or district ('Nürnberg, Mittelfranken' -> 'Nürnberg'). null if only a country/region is given.
city.title: City

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'DE', 'AT', 'CH'. Use 'DE' for German cities. null if unknown.
country.title: Country

min.description: Lower bound as a plain number in the stated currency and period. '65.000 €' -> 65000; '4.500,50 €' -> 4500.5. For a single figure set min = max.
min.title: Min

max.description: Upper bound; same rules as min.
max.title: Max

description: Structured fields extracted from one job posting.

title.description: Job title as written, without gender suffixes like '(m/w/d)' or '(f/m/x)'.
title.title: Title

company.description: Hiring company as written. For staffing agencies use the agency name unless the client is named. null if absent.
company.title: Company

locations.description: All work locations mentioned. Empty list if none is given.
locations.title: Locations

remote_policy.description: remote = fully remote ('100% remote', 'Remote in Deutschland'); hybrid = some days at home ('2 Tage Homeoffice', 'mobiles Arbeiten möglich', 'hybrid'); onsite = explicitly on site or field/shift work that cannot be remote ('vor Ort'); unknown = not stated.

seniority.description: From the title or explicit wording. intern = Praktikum/internship/Werkstudent; junior = 'Junior', 'Berufseinsteiger', 'Absolvent', 0-2 years; mid = 2-5 years or 'Professional' without senior wording; senior = 'Senior', 'Lead' (individual), 5+ years; staff_plus = 'Staff', 'Principal', 'Head of', 'Director', 'Bereichsleiter'; unknown = no signal. Do not infer seniority from salary alone.

min_years_experience.description: Minimum years of experience stated as a number: '3+ Jahre' -> 3, 'mindestens 5 Jahre' -> 5, '2-4 years' -> 2. Vague wording like 'mehrjährige Erfahrung' or 'several years' -> null (not a number).
min_years_experience.title: Min Years Experience

required_skills.description: Hard skills, tools, certificates and licences that are required ('Voraussetzung', 'must have', 'Ihr Profil'). Lowercase; synonyms normalised ('k8s' -> 'kubernetes'). No soft skills ('teamfähig'), no languages (those go to languages_required).
required_skills.title: Required Skills

nice_to_have_skills.description: Skills marked optional: 'wünschenswert', 'von Vorteil', 'idealerweise', 'nice to have', 'a plus', 'bonus'. Same normalisation as required_skills.
nice_to_have_skills.title: Nice To Have Skills

languages_required.description: Spoken/written languages that are required. Optional languages ('Englisch von Vorteil') are not listed.
languages_required.title: Languages Required

english_sufficient.description: Can someone with English only do this job? Derived: 'no' if German at level good or above is required (enforced by the validator). 'yes' if the posting says English is enough or the working language is English and German is optional. Otherwise 'unclear'.

contract_type.description: permanent = 'unbefristet', 'Festanstellung', 'permanent'; fixed_term = 'befristet', 'fixed-term', 'Elternzeitvertretung'; freelance = 'freiberuflich', 'Freelancer', 'contractor'; internship = 'Praktikum', 'Pflichtpraktikum'; working_student = 'Werkstudent', 'working student'; unknown = not stated.

contract_duration_months.description: Duration in months for fixed-term, internship or working-student contracts: 'befristet auf 2 Jahre' -> 24, '6-monatiges Praktikum' -> 6. null otherwise.
contract_duration_months.title: Contract Duration Months

salary.description: Only explicit figures. null if no number is given ('attraktive Vergütung', 'nach Tarif' without a figure).

visa_sponsorship.description: yes = 'Visa sponsorship available', 'Unterstützung beim Visum'; no = 'no visa sponsorship', 'EU work permit required'; not_mentioned otherwise.

relocation_support.description: yes = 'relocation package', 'Umzugshilfe', 'Umzugskostenpauschale'; no = explicitly excluded; not_mentioned otherwise.

application_deadline.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of an explicit deadline ('Bewerbungsfrist: 15.12.2026' -> '2026-12-15'). null if none.
application_deadline.title: Application Deadline

posting_language.description: Main language of the posting text: 'en' or 'de'.

title: JobPosting
